Bexar County is the urban core of South Texas, containing San Antonio — the seventh-largest city in the United States — along with Alamo Heights, Leon Valley and the Randolph and Lackland military bases. Its economy runs on the military, healthcare and tourism, and growth pushes hardest along the far north and west edges, where the Edwards Aquifer recharge zone sets impervious-cover limits that decide what a tract can actually carry.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: September 12, 2026
